## What this PR changes



## Checklist

- [ ] **No vehicle-identifying or personal data** (VIN, plate, location, owner name, serial numbers, FAZIT, raw autoscan dumps).
- [ ] **No protection-bypass content** (Secure Boot / dm-verity / VW signing). Documenting *that* the protections exist and how the system is built is in scope; defeating them is not.
- [ ] **No proprietary material** (firmware binaries, confidential manuals, large blocks of decompiled proprietary code).
- [ ] **Confidence marked** (measured / disassembled / read-from-tool / inferred) and **sources cited**.
